blocks.x: Were there any locally based bands?

Yeah. Les Hite had a big band here.

Oh, Lawrence Brown was in it, Lionel Hampton. That's two big ones they had. And then there was another guy who had a band here. I can't think offhand -- But that's about it. There wasn't too much going on musically.
